38122.why: l4_reason describes a NATIONAL sectoral closure (radioactive-waste collection reserved to the State/BUMN and BAPETEN, closed to private/PMA capital) with nothing Bali-specific about it. Four fields nonetheless framed it as a Bali-only problem: whoThisIsFor's 'nationally... but not those needing a Bali-based entity' contrast, the headline's 'Closed in Bali', the standfirst's 'Bali blocks PMA registration', and the pullQuote's 'the Bali closure'. All four are corrected to state the actual mechanism (State/BAPETEN reservation, closed to private/PMA capital) without implying the reader could do this elsewhere in Indonesia. l4_reason is bare (no named law number, just a regulator name and an NB-3 citation), so per rule 2 no geographic word ('nationally'/'nationwide') was inserted into the restriction itself — only the pre-existing, pma_source-backed 'Nationally Open' clause (the separate positive-investment-list fact) was left standing in the headline. The byTheNumbers[3] card (value 'Closed (sector regulator)', label 'Bali status') was left untouched: its value doesn't itself assert Bali and is already accurate; the label can't be patched.
